title: FluxVLA Engine: A One-Stop VLA Engineering Platform for Embodied Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2609.17210v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models, world-action models (WAMs), and offline reinforcement learning methods are rapidly expanding the design space of embodied policies, yet turning these algorithms into reliable robot systems remains constrained by fragmented data formats, training stacks, evaluation protocols, inference runtimes, and embodiment-specific interfaces. We present $\mathrm{FluxVLA}$ Engine, an open, configuration-driven platform that turns heterogeneous embodied-policy components into a reproducible data-to-deployment workflow. Rather than introducing another policy model, $\mathrm{FluxVLA}$ standardizes interfaces for datasets, visual-language and world models, action heads, reward- or advantage-weighted learning, distributed training, simulation evaluation, optimized inference, and robot operators. The engine further integrates compositional dual-arm simulation, scalable automatic data generation, and model-decoupled hum

translated_title: FluxVLA引擎：面向具身智能的一站式VLA工程平台
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型、世界-动作模型（WAM）以及离线强化学习方法正在迅速扩展具身策略的设计空间，然而将这些算法转化为可靠的机器人系统，仍然受到碎片化的数据格式、训练框架、评估协议、推理运行时以及特定本体接口的制约。我们提出了FluxVLA Engine，一个开放的、配置驱动的平台，它将异构的具身策略组件转化为可复现的从数据到部署的工作流。FluxVLA并不是引入又一个策略模型，而是为数据集、视觉-语言与世界模型、动作头、基于奖励或优势加权的学习、分布式训练、仿真评估、优化推理以及机器人操作器等环节标准化了接口。该引擎进一步集成了可组合的双臂仿真、可扩展的自动化数据生成以及模型解耦的人形……（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: FluxVLA Engine是一个开放、配置驱动的一站式工程平台，通过为数据集、模型、训练、仿真评估、推理部署和机器人操作等全流程环节标准化接口，将异构的具身策略组件整合为可复现的从数据到部署的完整工作流。
en_tdlr: FluxVLA Engine is an open, configuration-driven one-stop engineering platform that standardizes interfaces across datasets, models, training, simulation evaluation, inference deployment, and robot operators, turning heterogeneous embodied-policy components into a reproducible data-to-deployment workflow.
